title: Advantage-level Aggregation Reinforcement Learning for X-point Target Magnetic Configuration Control in an EXL-50U Experiment-Calibrated Simulation Environment
abstract: arXiv:2608.20834v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Managing divertor heat loads is a central challenge for compact, high-power tokamaks. To increase local flux expansion and decouple the dissipation volume from the core, EHL-2 adopts the X-point target (XPT) divertor. This requires the secondary X-point to remain on the divertor leg; displacement degrades the topology and exhaust geometry. Current experiments, including EXL-50U discharges, rely on precomputed feedforward waveforms with PID loops on global quantities. Lacking dedicated closed-loop feedback for the secondary null, XPT operation is repeatable but not routine. We formulate XPT feedback as a multi-objective reinforcement learning (RL) control problem in a free-boundary environment calibrated to EXL-50U discharge #13906. To address strong coupling among plasma current, shape, and null constraints - where reward scalarisation collapses objective-specific temporal credit - we develop Advantage Aggregation (AdvA). translated_title: 面向EXL-50U实验校准仿真环境中X点靶板磁构型控制的优势聚合强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20834v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：管理偏滤器热负荷是紧凑型高功率托卡马克的核心挑战。为增加局部磁通量扩张并将耗散体积与芯部解耦，EHL-2采用了X点靶板（XPT）偏滤器。这要求次级X点保持在偏滤器支腿上；位移会降低拓扑结构和排热几何性能。当前实验，包括EXL-50U放电，依赖于预计算的前馈波形和基于全局量的PID回路。由于缺乏针对次级零点的专用闭环反馈，XPT运行可重复但非例行化。我们将XPT反馈表述为一个多目标强化学习（RL）控制问题，在针对EXL-50U放电#13906校准的自由边界环境中进行。为解决等离子体电流、形状和零点约束之间的强耦合——其中奖励标量化会破坏目标特定的时间信用分配——我们开发了优势聚合（AdvA）。AdvA保留了...
tldr: 本文提出一种基于优势聚合（AdvA）的多目标强化学习方法，用于在EXL-50U校准仿真环境中实现对X点靶板磁构型的闭环反馈控制，解决了传统标量化奖励在强耦合约束下时间信用分配失效的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Advantage Aggregation (AdvA) based multi-objective reinforcement learning method for closed-loop feedback control of X-point target magnetic configuration in an EXL-50U-calibrated simulation environment, addressing the collapse of temporal credit assignment in scalarized rewards under strongly coupled constraints.
